title: NVIDIA Riva Triton Inference Server Missing Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to access protected functionality on affected installations of NVIDIA Riva. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the configuration of the Triton Inference Server. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to access the Triton Inference Server API on the target system.
